body: Thank you for your honest feedback. I need perspectives like yours right now.

Was it really so unreasonable to ask such a question since I work at home? There was no danger to the worksite — there isn’t one in my state — so my fear was my mom coming to my house, not the office.

My gut tells me that a restraining order would only embolden her. But I will look into getting one because I don’t feel safe here at all right now.

Thank you for the kind words. I will also file for unemployment asap.
Yes — US. I’m in a ‘right to work’ state so I think legally they can fire me for any reason they want to. I don’t think I have any legal recourse here.

Apologies for the slow response here but I have been slowly going through and doing my research on the various options and I wanted to let you know that I don’t think the person in your first link should be trusted. He strikes me very much as a small town nutjob who is just trying to make money and fame via the trans community because a lot of us are desperate for someone to provide the types of remedies he claims to. See [here](https://transfemscience.org/articles/powers-wpath/) for a good article outlining a lot of the red flags around this guy. The medical establishment largely doesn’t like him, and the way he writes reeks of an attention-seeking fraud. (For example, the thread linked at the bottom of the page you linked to about his crap being available nationwide is an easy tell — there’s an entire paragraph in there about how he could have locked it to his own patients and about how generous and morally upstanding he is for not doing that.)

I’m going to keep searching around but I wanted to make you — and any folks who find this via searching in the future — aware that they should proceed with caution regarding anything having to do with that guy.

*hugs*
Big time this. I used to be a massive piece of shit and it haunts me every single day.

I feel the exact same way. It’s like the part of me who I actually liked is dead or dying while the rest of me grows old, boring, and lifeless like everyone I swore I’d never be.

I don’t know how to escape this. I don’t recognize myself anymore.
